Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Africa Kenya confirms eighth Ebola case as regional outbreak spreads Source : Reuters 19 October 2026 12:03am Audio By Carbonatix
Kenya has confirmed one more ​Ebola case, bringing the total number of ‌infections in the country to eight, Director-General for Health Patrick Amoth said on Sunday.
"Today, 38 people were tested, and one ​tested positive for Ebola," Amoth said in an ​interview on Kenya's Citizen TV.
"He is a ⁠49-year-old man who is not a healthcare worker. He ​developed fever, headache and muscle pain."
Amoth said the new ​case was a patient attendant who cleaned utensils and linens, and he was probably exposed to Kenya's first Ebola case, ​discovered earlier this month, in a man who travelled ​from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died at a ‌Nairobi ⁠hospital on October 5.
The latest case developed symptoms on Saturday, was separated from other people in quarantine, and was tested for the virus, with the result ​returning positive on ​Sunday, a ⁠health ministry source said.
Kenya has been on heightened alert, as a major Ebola outbreak ​centered in Congo has spread across borders ​in ⁠the region.
Congo confirmed on Sunday that its outbreak had spread to an eighth province, North Ubangi, underscoring concerns ⁠about ​wider regional transmission.
